## V1 - close path

`store.py:close` flushes the write buffer before marking the item done.
The new test `test_close_flushes` writes one op, closes, then reads back
the stored row. Behavioural and tied to the fix.

## V2 - token check

`auth.py:check` rejects an empty token before touching the store. The test
`test_empty_token_refused` asserts the refusal without seeding state. No
test-only branches were added; production code has no test sniffing.
